page.overview:
Who is O'Neil Family?

O'Neil's Family in Fazbear Frights comprises the relatives of Sam O'Neil from Blackbird, the first story of Fazbear Frights 6: Blackbird.

Sam O'Neil is the deuteragonist of the sixth Fazbear Frights book's first story.

Paul O'Neil is Sam's father. He's really nice to Nole and supportive of Sam. Paul helps get the feathers needed for the Blackbird costume. He is devastated when Sam goes missing and his blood is found on the tracks.

Molly O'Neil is Sam's mother. She's really nice to Nole and supportive of Sam. Molly is devastated when Sam goes missing and his blood is found on the tracks.
